{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
df['is_qa'] = (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)

# Define the target population: new customers via paid_search
# Exclude QA orders from the analysis
target_population = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & ~df['is_qa']]

# Compute conversion rate
converted_count = target_population['converted'].sum()
total_count = len(target_population)
conversion_rate = converted_count / total_count

print(f"Number of QA orders in target population: {len(df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & df['is_qa']])}")
print(f"Number of valid (non-QA) customers in target population: {len(target_population)}")
print(f"Number of conversions among valid customers: {converted_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate (fraction): {conversion_rate}")"}
